glosses: to overturn, to nose over (crash by landing such that the nose of the plane hits the ground first, causing the plane to topple forward)

examples.text: Łabicki kapotował podczas przymusowego lądowania raniąc poważnie twarz. Został umieszczony w szpitalu lubelskim.
examples.translation: Łabicki nosed over during a forced landing seriously injuring his face. He was placed in a Lublin hospital.
